semiconductor_relevance: High — United Precision Technologies Co., Ltd. specializes in precision metal parts and test sockets that are critical for semiconductor electrical testing.
summary: United Precision Technologies Co., Ltd. (UPT) is a leading manufacturer of precision metal parts essential for small electronic components, particularly in the semiconductor industry. They produce high-performance test sockets and components that support advanced technologies such as AI, self-driving vehicles, and healthcare services.
capabilities: Optical image stabilization springs for smartphone cameras
Contact sockets and components for semiconductor electrical testing
Cooling plates with microchannels and cooling components

regional_presence.Japan: UPT is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan, where it focuses on high-quality manufacturing and innovation.
